result:
Generated `outputs/00_contents.json` with the Proposal Content Brief.

**Summary of extraction:**

| Section | Status |
|---------|--------|
| `proposal_inputs` | Populated with context, raw ideas, governing thought seed, key claims, available facts; `raw_data_or_charts` marked TODO |
| `stakeholder_synergy` | 3 stakeholders identified (Nyx Foundation, Target Sponsor, UTokyo); 1 TODO for additional sponsors |
| `executive_summary` | Complete one-liner, target audience, decision request, why-now |
| `problem` / `impact` | Extracted pain points, root causes, affected parties; metrics include Fusaka audit (explicit) + literature count (hypothesis) |
| `future_state` | Goals and success metrics with explicit/hypothesis evidence tags |
| `proposal` | Solution overview, capabilities, scope, assumptions documented |
| `differentiation` | Why-this list + 3 alternatives with pros/cons |
| `proof` | 4 evidence items (benchmark, case study, funding, theory); 4 evidence-needed TODOs |
| `feasibility` | Build model; requirements by category; governance RACI draft with TODOs for decision maker and escalation |
| `plan` | 4 phases (prep, registration, competition, post); durations marked TODO |
| `risks` | 6 risks with mitigations; owners marked TODO |
| `cost_roi` | Prize pool explicit (16M JPY); other costs TODO; ROI primarily non-financial |
| `cta` | Decision request clear; budget/timeline marked TODO |
| `terminology` | 9 terms with plain-English definitions and business value links |
| `unknowns_todo` | 12 explicit TODOs with why-needed and suggested owners |

**No facts were invented.** All unknowns are captured in `unknowns_todo`. Terminology is consistent throughout.
